name: @limio/ot-step-header
description: Checkout accordion step header (custom subcomponent for the stock checkout form). Numbered badge, check mark once completed, one-line summary of what was entered and an Edit link when collapsed. Fields join a step via the ot-section-N class; the hide/show CSS lives in the page's pageStyle. Adapted from stripe-demo's sports-step-header.

limioProps.label: Collapsed summary template, e.g. {{customerDetails.firstName}} · {{customerDetails.email}} (use {{paymentType}} for the payment step)
